46. Event-driven architecture basics

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Event-driven architecture lets components react to facts published as events. Asynchronous
delivery introduces duplicate, ordering and consistency concerns.

Q: Is event-driven architecture automatically reliable?
A: No. Delivery guarantees, retries, idempotency, observability and failure handling are needed.
